seanshine.pl: Inchintotane, Newmarket, Co. Cork → Adel, Oregon
facts: "Sean, 5, son" in the 1926 census at Inchantotane — the seventh of eight children then at home: Humphrey, Mollie, Patrick, Norah, William, Bridie, Sean and Thomas

Came to Oregon in 1948 — to the Guano Valley, then Warner Valley; took over his uncle Jack McCarthy's ranch at Adel and ranched for over 40 years

Came to Lake County, Oregon, at about 19 — around 1900; lived a few years in San Francisco, where he married Mary O'Keefe, then ranched at Drews Gap west of Lakeview

The Verlings were a Cove of Cork family — the town's Dr James Roche Verling sailed with Napoleon to St Helena in 1815.
